The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Alert Event ASIM filtering parser for Google Cloud Security Command Center (GoogleCloudSCC)
properties.query:
// ASIM's Hostname logical type is a single DNS label
let HostnameFormatRegex = @'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$';
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , hostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , attacktactics_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , attacktechniques_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , threatcategory_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , alertverdict_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventseverity_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    GoogleCloudSCC
    | where not(disabled)
    | where
        (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(alertverdict_has_any) == 0 // Source does not support AlertVerdict
    | extend
        _FindingClass = tostring(Findings.findingClass)
        , _Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
    // SCC_ERROR findings report SCC operational errors, not security alerts
    | where _FindingClass != "SCC_ERROR"
    | extend
        EventSeverity = case(
            _Severity in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High"
            , _Severity == "MEDIUM", "Medium"
            , _Severity == "LOW", "Low"
            , "Informational"
        )
    | where array_length(eventseverity_has_any) == 0 or EventSeverity in~ (eventseverity_has_any)
    | extend
        _Category = tostring(Findings.category)
        , _SourceName = coalesce(tostring(Findings.parentDisplayName), tostring(Findings.sourceDisplayName))
        , _SP = iff(array_length(bag_keys(SourceProperties)) > 0, SourceProperties, Findings.sourceProperties)
    | extend
        EventSubType = case(
            _FindingClass == "THREAT", "Threat"
            , _FindingClass == "OBSERVATION", "Suspicious Activity"
            , _FindingClass in ("VULNERABILITY", "SECRET", "EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE", "TOXIC_COMBINATION", "CHOKEPOINT"), "Vulnerability"
            , _FindingClass in ("POSTURE_VIOLATION", "SENSITIVE_DATA_RISK"), "Policy Violation"
            , "Compliance Violation"
        )
    | extend
        ThreatCategory = case(
            _Category has "Ransomware", "Ransomware"
            , _Category has_any ("Cryptomining", "Cryptocurrency Mining", "Coin Mining"), "Cryptominer"
            , _Category has "Phishing", "Phishing"
            , _Category has "Rootkit", "Rootkit"
            , _Category has "Malicious URL", "MaliciousUrl"
            , _Category has "Malware", "Malware"
            , EventSubType in ("Compliance Violation", "Policy Violation"), "Security Policy Violation"
            , "Unknown"
        )
    | where array_length(threatcategory_has_any) == 0 or ThreatCategory in~ (threatcategory_has_any)
    | extend
        _TacticList = set_difference(
            array_concat(
                pack_array(tostring(Findings.mitreAttack.primaryTactic))
                , todynamic(coalesce(tostring(Findings.mitreAttack.additionalTactics), "[]"))
            )
            , dynamic(["", "TACTIC_UNSPECIFIED"])
        )
        , _TechniqueList = set_difference(
            array_concat(
                todynamic(coalesce(tostring(Findings.mitreAttack.primaryTechniques), "[]"))
                , todynamic(coalesce(tostring(Findings.mitreAttack.additionalTechniques), "[]"))
            )
            , dynamic(["", "TECHNIQUE_UNSPECIFIED"])
        )
    | extend
        // SCC MITRE values are enum names (e.g. COMMAND_AND_CONTROL), not ATT&CK IDs
        AttackTactics = replace_string(strcat_array(_TacticList, ", "), "_", " ")
        , AttackTechniques = replace_string(strcat_array(_TechniqueList, ", "), "_", " ")
    | where array_length(attacktactics_has_any) == 0 or AttackTactics has_any (attacktactics_has_any)
    | where array_length(attacktechniques_has_any) == 0 or AttackTechniques has_any (attacktechniques_has_any)
    | extend
        Username = tostring(Findings.access.principalEmail)
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or Username has_any (username_has_any)
    | extend
        _ResourceName = tostring(Findings.resourceName)
        , _ResType = tostring(FindingsResource.type)
        , _ResDisplayName = coalesce(tostring(FindingsResource.displayName), tostring(FindingsResource.display_name))
    | extend
        _InstanceName = iff(
            _ResType == "google.compute.Instance" or _ResourceName has "/instances/"
            , coalesce(_ResDisplayName, extract(@'/instances/([^/]+)$', 1, _ResourceName))
            , ""
        )
    | extend
        DvcHostname = iff(_InstanceName matches regex HostnameFormatRegex, _InstanceName, "")
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0 or DvcHostname has_any (hostname_has_any)
    // The resource's own IP is preferred; the caller IP (actor) is the fallback.
    // Non-IP caller values such as "private" or "gce-internal-ip" are dropped.
    | extend
        _IpCandidate = coalesce(tostring(Findings.externalExposure.privateIpAddress), tostring(Findings.access.callerIp))
    | extend
        DvcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv6(_IpCandidate)), _IpCandidate, "")
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DvcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(DvcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | extend
        _EventTime = todatetime(Findings.eventTime)
        , _CreateTime = todatetime(Findings.createTime)
        , _State = tostring(Findings.state)
        , _Description = tostring(Findings.description)
        , _Explanation = tostring(_SP.Explanation)
        , _PrincipalSubject = tostring(Findings.access.principalSubject)
        , _ProjectName = coalesce(
            tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata["project"])
            , tostring(FindingsResource["project"])
            , tostring(FindingsResource.project_name)
        )
        , _ProjectDisplayName = coalesce(
            tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
            , tostring(FindingsResource.projectDisplayName)
            , tostring(FindingsResource.project_display_name)
        )
        , _AttackExposureScore = todouble(Findings.attackExposure.score)
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(_EventTime, TimeGenerated)
        , EventEndTime = coalesce(_EventTime, TimeGenerated)
        , EventCount = toint(1)
        , EventType = "Alert"
        , EventResult = "NA"
        , EventProduct = "Security Command Center"
        , EventVendor = "Google"
        , EventSchema = "AlertEvent"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , EventUid = tostring(Findings.name)
        , EventOriginalUid = tostring(Findings.canonicalName)
        , EventOriginalType = _FindingClass
        , EventOriginalSeverity = _Severity
        , EventMessage = coalesce(_Description, _Explanation, _Category)
        , EventReportUrl = coalesce(
            tostring(Findings.externalUri)
            , tostring(_SP.contextUris.cloudLoggingQueryUri[0].url)
        )
        , AlertName = _Category
        , AlertOriginalStatus = _State
        , AlertStatus = case(
            _State == "ACTIVE", "Active"
            , _State == "INACTIVE", "Closed"
            , ""
        )
        , RuleName = coalesce(tostring(_SP.detectionCategory.ruleName), _Category)
        , RuleDescription = _Explanation
        , AttackRemediationSteps = coalesce(tostring(Findings.nextSteps), tostring(_SP.Recommendation))
        , DetectionMethod = case(
            _SourceName has "Threat Detection" or _SourceName == "Sensitive Actions Service", "Behavioral Analytics"
            , _SourceName == "Web Security Scanner", "Cloud Application Security"
            , _SourceName in ("Security Health Analytics", "Security Posture", "Data Security Posture Management", "Risk Engine", "External Exposure"), "Cloud Security Posture Management"
            // Sources not listed above fall back to the finding class
            , _FindingClass in ("THREAT", "OBSERVATION"), "Behavioral Analytics"
            , _FindingClass in ("MISCONFIGURATION", "POSTURE_VIOLATION", "SENSITIVE_DATA_RISK", "VULNERABILITY", "SECRET", "EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE", "TOXIC_COMBINATION", "CHOKEPOINT"), "Cloud Security Posture Management"
            , "Other"
        )
        , ThreatFirstReportedTime = _CreateTime
        , ThreatLastReportedTime = _EventTime
        , ThreatIsActive = _State == "ACTIVE"
        , ThreatOriginalRiskLevel = iff(_AttackExposureScore > 0, tostring(_AttackExposureScore), "")
        , ThreatRiskLevel = iff(_AttackExposureScore > 0, toint(round(_AttackExposureScore * 10)), int(null))
        , UsernameType = case(
            isempty(Username), ""
            , Username has "@", "UPN"
            , "Simple"
        )
        , UserType = case(
            isempty(Username), ""
            , Username endswith "gserviceaccount.com", "Service Principal"
            , "Regular"
        )
        , UserId = _PrincipalSubject
        , UserIdType = iff(isnotempty(_PrincipalSubject), "Other", "")
        , OriginalUserType = extract(@'^([^:]+):', 1, _PrincipalSubject)
        , DvcId = _ResourceName
        , DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(_ResourceName), "Other", "")
        , DvcScopeId = extract(@'projects/([^/]+)$', 1, _ProjectName)
        , DvcScope = _ProjectDisplayName
        , IndicatorType = case(
            isnotempty(_InstanceName), "Host"
            , isnotempty(Username), "User"
            , "Cloud Resource"
        )
    | extend
        AlertId = EventUid
        , AlertDescription = EventMessage
        , Url = EventReportUrl
        , Rule = RuleName
        , User = Username
        , Hostname = DvcHostname
        , IpAddr = DvcIpAddr
        , Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname, EventProduct)
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , pack(
                "SourceDisplayName", _SourceName
                , "Compliances", Findings.compliances
                , "AttackExposure", Findings.attackExposure
                , "Access", Findings.access
                , "ExternalExposure", Findings.externalExposure
                , "Vulnerability", Findings.vulnerability
                , "SecurityMarks", Findings.securityMarks
                , "Mute", Findings.mute
                , "Resource", FindingsResource
                , "SourceProperties", _SP
            )
            , dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventCount
        , EventType
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventSeverity
        , EventOriginalSeverity
        , EventProduct
        , EventVendor
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventUid
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventMessage
        , EventReportUrl
        , Url
        , AlertName
        , AlertId
        , AlertDescription
        , AlertOriginalStatus
        , AlertStatus
        , AttackTactics
        , AttackTechniques
        , AttackRemediationSteps
        , DetectionMethod
        , RuleName
        , RuleDescription
        , Rule
        , ThreatCategory
        , ThreatFirstReportedTime
        , ThreatLastReportedTime
        , ThreatIsActive
        , ThreatOriginalRiskLevel
        , ThreatRiskLevel
        , Username
        , UsernameType
        , UserId
        , UserIdType
        , UserType
        , OriginalUserType
        , User
        , DvcId
        , DvcIdType
        , DvcHostname
        , DvcIpAddr
        , DvcScopeId
        , DvcScope
        , Dvc
        , Hostname
        , IpAddr
        , IndicatorType
        , AdditionalFields
        , Type
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime
    , endtime=endtime
    , ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix
    , hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any
    , username_has_any=username_has_any
    , attacktactics_has_any=attacktactics_has_any
    , attacktechniques_has_any=attacktechniques_has_any
    , threatcategory_has_any=threatcategory_has_any
    , alertverdict_has_any=alertverdict_has_any
    , eventseverity_has_any=eventseverity_has_any
    , disabled=disabled
    , pack=pack
)
